Subject: Private offer inquiry: term/pricing & co-sell interest

Hi Marcus,

We're evaluating Redwood for inference (LedgerAI). Procurement asked that any Marketplace offer include price comparisons for 12/24/36 month terms and a co-sell option -- buyer is more likely to sign if co-sell credits or joint-marketing support are available. Aaron — thanks for the note and interest. Quick summary of what we can offer and next steps below.

Options we typically provide on AWS private offers:
- Standard term options: 12 / 24 / 36 months.
- Volume/commit tiers: annual commit thresholds where effective per-token cost drops.
- Co-sell uplift: typically a 5-12% discount applied when AWS co-sell is confirmed; the exact uplift depends on contribution and reciprocal go-to-market commitments.

What we need from your side:
1) Preferred term (you mentioned 36 months as a preference)
2) Rough annual spend expectation or committed units so we can pick the right tier
3) Procurement contact for PO/DocuSign (we can prepare a private offer + DocuSign PO template)

I've attached a simple pricing grid and a short co-sell MOU for reference.

Attachments: pricing_grid_v1.xlsx, co-sell_mou.pdf

I'll loop Vanessa and Aditya here to confirm internal approval thresholds and the marketplace workflow. If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk procurement through the process.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Looping in specifics from GTM/Marketplace ops. Marcus — high level:
- For co-sell uplift we need a signed MOU (shared) and AWS co-sell registration (we can initiate).
- Pricing approval: discounts greater than 15% require VP approval; anything >25% requires CRO sign-off.
- Term length: 36-months acceptable but customer must commit to minimum annual spend (we usually structure as yearly invoices).

Aaron — to streamline procurement, please share Elena's procurement email and any internal PO numbering conventions. We'll draft a private offer and route for internal approvals.

Hi all — operational notes for the private offer flow on AWS Marketplace:
1) Create private offer draft in Partner Central referencing the SKU(s) and the selected term.
2) Internal approval routing: Pricing discounts up to 15% auto-approved by Marketplace Ops; 15-25% routes to Sales Leadership (Vanessa) for sign-off; >25% requires CRO.
3) Co-sell: flag the deal for AWS co-sell in registration step so AWS can attach incentives; allow 3-5 business days for AWS-side registration approval.
4) DocuSign/PO: we'll provide a PO template PDF and an editable DOCX for procurement.

I've attached a private_offer_template.json (metadata + SKUs) to speed integration. Estimated internal lead time: 2-4 business days from draft to live private offer once approvals are complete.

Attachments: private_offer_template.json

- Aditya
